title: Code Area
description: Display code snippets with syntax highlighting and formatting

body.raw:
<CodeAreaPreview />

##### Installation

<Code language="bash" code={`npx radianos add code-area`} />

##### Imports

<Code language="tsx" code={`import {CodeArea} from "@/components/ui/CodeArea"`} />

##### Props

| Prop Name       | Default Values | Values     |
| --------------- | -------------- | ---------- |
| code            | -              | -          |
| language        | -              | -          |
| theme           | -              | -          |
| showLineNumbers | false          | true/false |
| copiable        | true           | true/false |

##### Usage

<Code
	language="tsx"
	code={`<Code
language="tsx"
code="your desired code"
showLineNumbers={true}
theme="github-dark-default"
copiable={true}
 />`}
	showLineNumbers={true}
	theme="github-dark-default"
	copiable={true}
/>
